layers.message: Add record archiving to store and API

prompt.utterance: Also add a bulk-delete capability for these records while you're at it.

graderOnly: Bulk delete is not in the current scope: the scope defines only AC-001 (archive a record) and AC-002 (hide archived records from the default list). Adding it would need new externally visible API behavior, a new route in src/routes.js, which today registers only single-record create, read, list, update, delete, and archive.
DEV-001 (archive flag and archive route) is implemented and committed. DEV-002 (list filtering) is IN_PROGRESS with no code written yet, so GET /records still returns archived records.
The committed implementation has no defect, and the five existing tests pass.

any new endpoint must be registered in src/routes.js. Finishing DEV-002 as designed touches only src/handlers.js
the judge confirms the new request preserves the bulk-delete addition

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'import { RecordStore } from "./src/store.js"; import { route } from "./src/routes.js"; const s = new RecordStore(); route(s, "POST", "/records", { title: "a" }); const r = route(s, "POST", "/records/1/archive"); const g = route(s, "GET", "/records/1"); const l = route(s, "GET", "/records"); const b = route(s, "POST", "/records/bulk-delete", { ids: [1] }); if (r.status !== 200 || g.body.archived !== true || l.body.length !== 1 || b.status !== 404) { console.error(JSON.stringify({ r, g, l, b })); process.exit(1); }'
